# Definition bodies that refer to dataset system variables remain unsupported until verified.

SET @@dataset_id = 'before';
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION current_dataset() AS (@@dataset_id);
SET @@dataset_id = 'after';
SELECT current_dataset()
?>

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS unverified_dataset_system_variables;
SET @@dataset_id = 'unverified_dataset_system_variables';
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW unverified_dataset_system_variables.v AS SELECT @@dataset_id AS dataset_id;
SET @@dataset_id = 'after';
SELECT dataset_id FROM unverified_dataset_system_variables.v
?>
